spec_coverage.notes: §8.1: app/javascript/shared/queryHooks/useAiJobCriteria.ts matches the spec's verbatim code character-for-character — AiJobCriterion and AiJobCriteriaPayload interfaces (tier union tier_1/tier_2/tier_3; status union pending/in_progress/succeeded/failed/retrying/null; zeroCriteriaFailure boolean|null, no fabricated fallback), query key ["aiJobCriteria", jobId], enabled: jobId != undefined guard, useRegenerateAiJobCriteria with hook-level onSuccess invalidation of ["aiJobCriteria", variables.jobId]. §8.6: the new case sits at WebsocketGlobalChannelHandler.tsx:250-261, directly after the AI_SUMMARY_FAILED block (ends line 248) and before AI_SUMMARY_BULK_FAILED, matching the spec code block verbatim: succeeded → success toast 'Job criteria generated for {jobTitle}'; zeroCriteriaFailure → warning 'No criteria found in the job description for {jobTitle}'; else → warning 'Could not generate job criteria for {jobTitle}'; all delay 10000; queryCache.invalidateQueries(["aiJobCriteria", Number(payload.jobId)]) fires on every branch (queryCache is this file's useQueryClient() identifier, line 11). Import of JobCriteriaExtractionCompletePayload added on the existing line-7 import per §8.7. §8.7: JobCriteriaExtractionCompletePayload interface exact shape (status "succeeded"|"failed", jobId number, jobTitle string, zeroCriteriaFailure boolean, errorMessage optional); header comment changed 'AI summary WebSocket broadcasts' → 'AI WebSocket broadcasts'. Diff-to-spec: git diff develop...HEAD for the three files contains ONLY the specified additions — no other hunks (the aiSummaryWebsocketPayloads.ts no-trailing-newline EOF state is unchanged from develop). Cross-checks: backend broadcast_completion (app/jobs/extract_job_criteria_job.rb:51-57) sends status/jobId/jobTitle/zeroCriteriaFailure + conditional errorMessage — field-for-field and casing match with the TS interface, and the terminal-status guard (line 49) means only 'succeeded'/'failed' ever reach the wire, matching the two-value TS union; errorMessage optionality matches the backend's conditional inclusion. Behavioral walk: succeeded rows can never have zeroCriteriaFailure true (zero_criteria_failure? requires status_failed?), so the three branches partition the variants exactly as §8.6 specifies. Invalidation-key match: the query registers ["aiJobCriteria", job.id] (JobCriteriaSection.tsx:30, job = passedJob from JobSetupAiSettings.tsx:107 — serialized job id, a JSON number); the handler invalidates ["aiJobCriteria", Number(payload.jobId)] where payload.jobId arrives as a JS number (Ruby integer job_id through ActionCable JSON), so Number() is a harmless no-op and key shapes match exactly; the mutation's invalidation key uses the number-typed jobId prop of RegenerateJobCriteriaConfirmModal — same key shape. Copy rules (DECISIONS): all three toast titles are sentence case, no em dashes, no emoji, no buttons/links, no interpolated counts; 'generate' vocabulary is consistent with the decided empty-state/button copy and does not violate the 'extract never read' rule.
